vibe_rationale: Maker-led illustration, comics and zine community with near-free entry and a welcoming, curated feel, though a narrow single scene at small scale.
fit_notes: A niche illustration and zine hobby crowd with little health relevance, but a low-cost stall is a cheap credibility play. Only council and venue support so far, so a first non-endemic brand presence would stand out, and the founders deal directly.
